angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,215,388 km at 131.36 pc = 0.12 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.6125 +/- 0.0174 mas (same row, RUWE 1.08): 131.36 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.747 +/- 0.049 solar radii from Yu et al. 2018, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 89345 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..127Y/abstract): 1,215,388 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.157 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Yu et al. 2018, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 89345 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..127Y/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5576 +/- 73 K from Yu et al. 2018, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 89345 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..127Y/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Yu et al. 2018, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 89345 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..127Y/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-89345.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.017, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 89345 (pscomppars): spectral type G5, from Bourrier et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...669A..63B/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 89345: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 89345 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.421 dex, from Yu et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..127Y/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 89345 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.42488, from Yu et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..127Y/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 89345 (pscomppars): age 7.53 Gyr, from Yu et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..127Y/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 89345 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 0.58 km/s, from Bourrier et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...669A..63B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
